db:update.doc:name: Flags -> REPORTED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE transaction_flags SET report_status = 'REPORTED', reported_run_id = :runId WHERE flagged_at >= :periodStart AND flagged_at < :periodEnd AND report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT'

raise-error.description: #['Expected ' ++ (vars.fin.expectedFlagUpdates as String) ++ ' flags to be marked REPORTED but ' ++ (vars.flagsUpdated as String) ++ ' matched. Flags changed after extraction - run must be repeated.']

db:update.doc:name: Run -> SUCCESS
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE compliance_report_runs SET sequence_number = :sequenceNumber, run_status = 'SUCCESS', completed_at = NOW() WHERE run_id = :runId AND run_status = 'STARTED'

raise-error.description: #['Run ' ++ vars.fin.runId ++ ' is not in STARTED state']

db:update.doc:name: Advance control
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE compliance_report_control SET last_reported_upto = :periodEnd, last_successful_run = :runId, last_sequence_number = :sequenceNumber, updated_at = NOW() WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode AND last_reported_upto = :periodStart
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: vars.fin.runId, sequenceNumber: vars.fin.sequenceNumber, reportType: vars.fin.reportType, entityCode: vars.fin.entityCode, periodStart: vars.fin.periodStart, periodEnd: vars.fin.periodEnd }]

raise-error.description: #['Bookmark is no longer at ' ++ vars.fin.periodStart ++ ' - another run already reported this period']

logger.doc:name: Log finalized
logger.message: #['finalized runId=' ++ vars.fin.runId ++ ' seq=' ++ (vars.fin.sequenceNumber as String) ++ ' flags=' ++ (vars.flagsUpdated as String) ++ ' controlAdvanced=' ++ (vars.fin.advanceControl as String)]

db:select.doc:name: Read bookmark
db:select.db:sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_reported_upto, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS last_reported_upto FROM compliance_report_control WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { runId: vars.fin.runId, flagsUpdated: vars.flagsUpdated as Number, controlAdvanced: vars.fin.advanceControl, lastReportedUpto: payload[0].last_reported_upto }
